answer: The task garden admits one bonded identity per agent: it locks 60 credits and passes a live skill check witnessed by two peers, checking fingerprint and work history before release after ten honest tasks. Each fake locks 60 credits plus an 8-credit fee, bound to one fingerprint and history and never reusable; a rented device with a fable history fails and forfeits its bond. The k-th identity from one wallet pays 68+5(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits and burn over 8,000 in fees. An honest agent pays once, with 60 refundable. A zenith audit at peak load slashes duplicates.
